lines: Well, hey there, sugar! Ain't you just the sweetest thing.
I'm Bramble. I grow things, and I fix up anybody who's feelin' poorly.
Sort of! More like a garden that gives hugs.
Portal's open, hon. The flowers by it glow brighter every time. Ain't that somethin'?
Mornin'! The flowers wake up the same time I do. We do our stretches together.
(Bramble stretches. A daisy nearby seems to stretch too.)
Shh, the plants are sleepin'. We gotta whisper so they grow nice and tall.

rotate: My best friend's from Scotland. She says 'wee' and I say 'y'all'.
Put us together and we're a whole dictionary!
You look a little tuckered out, darlin'. Want a pick-me-up?

lines: (Bramble pats Nina on the head. Tiny flowers pop up around her feet.)
There you go! Fresh as a daisy.
Alright! You holler if you need me.

rotate: Here's to more brain breaks! Sit in the grass a minute, sugar. It helps, I promise.
